name: Recreation Rest
overview: The Scriptures reveal that Jesus intentionally sought times of recreation rest to withdraw from the demands of His ministry. In Mark 6:31-32, He invites His disciples to come apart to a solitary place for rest, recognizing the necessity of retreat amid their busy work. Furthermore, Mark 7:24 shows Jesus seeking privacy and solitude even when ministering in new regions, underscoring the importance of rest and renewal for sustaining faithful service.
